content.text: GIMP's color theme has been changed to "Blue". Since GIMP 2.10.30 doesn't ship with a Blue theme by default (only Dark, Gray, Light, System), I created one at `~/.config/GIMP/2.10/themes/Blue/` by copying the Light theme and shifting its color palette to blue tones, then set `(theme "Blue")` in `~/.config/GIMP/2.10/gimprc`. After relaunch, GIMP picked it up — you can see the panels now have a soft blue tint instead of the previous dark gray, and "Blue" will appear in Edit → Preferences → Theme alongside the built-in themes.

result: GIMP's color theme has been changed to "Blue". Since GIMP 2.10.30 doesn't ship with a Blue theme by default (only Dark, Gray, Light, System), I created one at `~/.config/GIMP/2.10/themes/Blue/` by copying the Light theme and shifting its color palette to blue tones, then set `(theme "Blue")` in `~/.config/GIMP/2.10/gimprc`. After relaunch, GIMP picked it up — you can see the panels now have a soft blue tint instead of the previous dark gray, and "Blue" will appear in Edit → Preferences → Theme alongside the built-in themes.
